internal_measurement.results: Workspace tests, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, public-contract checks, deterministic USI smoke, WebAssembly Chrome tests, package generation, material-only SPSA contract tests, A/B runner tests, and a crates.io dry run passed. This release adds measurement and data-pipeline safeguards and makes no new playing-strength claim.

external_opponents.configuration: No external-engine result is used as release evidence for v0.3.57.

known_limitations: Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
No general playing-strength or external-engine superiority claim is made for this release.
No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
